title: Parameter Estimation Configurator
text: Generate configuration elements for PMSM parameter estimation, 1 output; {Number of pole pairs} sets the number of motor pole pairs, {Rated speed (RPM)} sets the motor rated speed, {Rated motor current (A)} sets the motor rated current, {Maximum inverter current (A)} sets the maximum measurable current, {Board resistance (ohm)} sets the inverter bridge resistance, {Current sense gain (A/ADC Count)} sets the current per ADC count, {Voltage sense gain (V/ADC Count)} sets the voltage per ADC count, {Maximum frequency (Hz)} sets the maximum frequency injected for frequency, {Minimum frequency (Hz)} sets the minimum frequency injected for frequency, {Step for frequency sweep (Hz)} sets the step size for frequency sweep, {Frequency step size for estimation (Hz)} sets the frequency step size for L d and L q, {Number of frequencies for estimation} sets the number of injected frequencies for L d and L q, {Current measurement delay (s)} sets the delay in current measurement, {Back EMF estimation time (s)} sets the motor run duration when estimating, {Back EMF estimation maximum speed limit (RPM)} sets the motor speed when estimating back-EMF, {Iq reference current as a ratio of rated motor current} sets the reference current for FOC when estimating K e, J, {Specify current controller gains} sets the pI current controller gains, {Proportional gain}, {Integral gain}, {Speed lower limit for inertia estimation (RPM)} sets the lower speed limit during coast-down and {Parameter estimation sample time (s)} sets the sample time for parameter. Values come from the instance.
